course.title: Stage 5 Industrial Technology - Metal industry
course.authority_boundary: Teacher to confirm local timetable, assessment and practical authority before delivery.
course.classification: Stage 5 elective — Industrial Technology – Metal industry

outcomes.statement: applies risk management and safe work practices in industrial technology contexts
communicates ideas and processes in industrial technology contexts
assesses the impact of industrial activities and practices on society and the environment
selects and applies design, project management and technical skills in project production
selects and justifies the use of materials, tools and equipment to undertake projects
evaluates the functional, aesthetic, economic and environmental qualities of products
analyses and applies a range of industrial processes in production contexts
demonstrates practical skills in the production of projects
investigates and explains a range of industry careers, enterprise opportunities and practices
